adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `createEvent` now chooses `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. The diff also shows `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` still supports a path where a `destinationCalendar` entry has **no** `credentialId` (the `else` branch: it filters credentials by `destination.integration` and calls `createEvent(c, event)` for each). In that integration-only/legacy case, `destinationCalendar` items can lack `credentialId`, so the `.find(...)` returns `undefined` and Google events will be inserted into `"primary"` even if `destinationCalendar[...].externalId` was set. This is a behavior regression from the previous unconditional `destinationCalendar.externalId` usage.
